meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 连接 xAI 后,Claude 会用 x_search 检索 X/Twitter 帖子:按日期限定时间敏感查询、圈定可信账号、拆成 2~3 次检索,并与 web_search 结果对照。报告时逐条附 x.com 链接,注明是某账号的帖子,而非已核实事实。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索 X/Twitter 帖子、查看某话题在 X 上的讨论,或提到 x_search 等关键词时接管;若未连接 xAI 凭据,它会说明工具不可用并改用 web_search。

say.text: 帮我搜一下 X 上最近关于 NVDA 的帖子
say.note: 按昨天起的日期限定,并去掉回复噪音

say.text: 只看 @growth_papa 这个账号最近在 X 上说了什么
say.note: 以该账号作为可信范围检索

say.text: 这条推文的回复和引用都拉出来看看
say.note: 会单独做一次线程抓取

howto.what_en: With xAI connected, Claude uses x_search to find X/Twitter posts: it date-bounds queries, scopes trusted accounts, splits into 2-3 searches, and reconciles with web_search. Each claim gets an x.com link and is labeled an X post, not a fact.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to search X/Twitter posts, check what people say about a topic on X, or mention x_search. Without an xAI credential it says the tool is unavailable and falls back to web_search.

say_en.text: Search X for recent posts about NVDA
say_en.note: Date-bounds from yesterday and drops replies.

say_en.text: What has @growth_papa posted on X lately?
say_en.note: Scopes the search to that handle.

say_en.text: Pull the replies and quotes for this post
